hooks.command: cd /home/user/hacs && [ -f .venv/bin/activate ] && source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null || true; python3 -c "import pct; print('[remote-control] HACS v' + pct.__version__ + ' pronto')" 2>/dev/null || echo '[remote-control] ambiente pronto'; echo "[hook] $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - Sessione MCP avviata" >> ./hacs/.mcp-hooks.log

INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -q 'pct/__init__\.py' && { VER=$(grep -oP '(?<=__version__ = ")[\d.]+' "$FILEPATH"); [ -n "$VER" ] && sed -i "s/^#  version: .*/#  version: $VER/" railway.toml && echo "[hook] railway.toml aggiornato a v$VER"; } || true

INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE 'design-system\.css|app\.css|mobile\.css' && { TS=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M); grep -l "design-system.css" ./hacs/web/templates/*.html 2>/dev/null | head -1 | xargs -I {} sed -i "s/design-system.css?v={{ app_version }}/design-system.css?v=${TS}/" {} && echo "[hook] CSS versionato a ${TS}"; } || true
